name: chimap
description: 목적지는 그대로, 가는 길은 더 건강하게.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @chimap/contracts build && pnpm --filter @chimap/app-core build && pnpm --filter @chimap/design-tokens build && pnpm --filter @chimap/api build && pnpm --filter @chimap/alert-relay build && pnpm --filter @chimap/web build
scripts.build:mobile: pnpm --filter @chimap/contracts build && pnpm --filter @chimap/app-core build && pnpm --filter @chimap/design-tokens build && pnpm --filter @chimap/mobile build
scripts.format:check: pnpm --filter @chimap/contracts build && pnpm --filter @chimap/app-core build && pnpm --filter @chimap/design-tokens build && pnpm -r format:check
scripts.test: pnpm boundaries:check && pnpm --filter @chimap/contracts build && pnpm --filter @chimap/app-core build && pnpm --filter @chimap/design-tokens build && pnpm -r --if-present test
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm --filter @chimap/contracts build && pnpm --filter @chimap/app-core build && pnpm --filter @chimap/design-tokens build && pnpm -r --if-present test:coverage
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @chimap/contracts build && pnpm --filter @chimap/app-core build && pnpm --filter @chimap/design-tokens build && pnpm -r --if-present typecheck
